protocol.outer_cv: Same 5 shared CAD-stratified development folds as v1
protocol.inner_cv: 3 target-stratified folds; preprocessing fit independently inside each training partition
protocol.selection_metric: Mean log loss on pooled inner OOF probabilities; select C, class weighting and sigmoid calibration together
protocol.calibration: Sigmoid with ensemble=False; each inner estimator calibrates on its own 3 cross-fitted subfolds; final outer estimator calibrates on 3 cross-fitted outer-training subfolds
protocol.classification_threshold: Different in each outer model: maximize F1 on its selected candidate's inner OOF probabilities over 0.05..0.95 in 0.01 steps
protocol.threshold_tie_break: Closest to 0.5, then the higher threshold
protocol.comparison: Outer validation evaluates the entire inner-selection procedure, not the best family selected by outer score. All family comparisons are exploratory development results.
protocol.auc_ci: 1000 patient bootstrap resamples of fixed development OOF predictions; conditional, excludes retraining and experiment-selection uncertainty
protocol.calibration_warning: A sigmoid calibration step does not establish calibrated patient probabilities; reliability bins are small and Brier combines calibration and discrimination
limitations: Small single dataset; no external or prospective validation.
V2 protocol was developed after viewing v1 development results. Final holdout remains frozen.
Inner model/threshold optimization scores are training diagnostics and are not performance claims.
Four independent predictions are not constrained to a joint CAD/vessel disease model.
F1-selected thresholds are research operating points, not medical recommendations.
protocol.experiment: Cumulative feature availability, separately fitted reduced-input models
protocol.full_55_policy: Reuse exact v2 full-55 excluding-fold models and scores
protocol.interpretation: Development comparison of available-input groups; not causal benefit, test utility, validated workflow or cost effectiveness
